title: Reproducibility and Final Upgrade Archive
paragraphs: Appendix K Reproducibility and Final Upgrade Archive This appendix documents the nal archive. It is written so that an examiner or a future researcher can reproduce the model-based results without reconstructing the project from memory. The archive is self-contained: the de-identied measured matrix, derived qualitative features, pipeline, R scripts, generated outputs, gures, and Colab notebooks are included. Identiable participant-observation material is kept in a restricted folder and is not required to reproduce the reported results; the pipeline falls back to aggregate qualitative features when the restricted le is absent. K.1 Archive Structure loklok-thesis-final-upgrade/ 01_thesis/ thesis_final.tex main manuscript src/ chapters, appendices, figures, diagrams src/generated/ pipeline macros and generated tables frontmatter/ Arabic title page and abstract build/ compiled PDF and logs 02_code/ pipeline/loklok_pipeline.py shared ABM/inference code pipeline/loklok_pipeline_v8.py final v8 original-data + BGE-M3 pipeline pipeline/generate_figures.py publication figures pipeline/requirements_v8.txt v8 Python dependencies colab/ T4 notebook and v8 bundle builder R/ reproduction and CFA scripts platform/ LOKLOK algorithm reference 03_data/ raw/ original 60-row survey, ride/PO data, FGD transcript, self-report audio 307

REPRODUCIBILITY AND FINAL UPGRADE ARCHIVE 308 measured/ de-identified N=52 and N=60 matrices qualitative/ FGD, self-report transcript, four corpora stimuli/ questionnaire and 25 briefs model_outputs/ JSON, CSV, NPZ, embeddings, posterior draws 04_figures/ png/ pdf/ source_data/ 300-DPI figures and plotting data 05_docs/ FINAL_UPGRADE_REPORT.md gap closure and change log GAP_CLOSURE_MATRIX.md review point -> action -> evidence DEFENSE_PLAYBOOK.md updated Q&A and claim ceilings CLAIM_EVIDENCE_MATRIX.md claim -> evidence tier -> status REPRODUCIBILITY.md commands and environment 06_archive/ original upgrade materials and prior PDF 07_validation/ verification logs and checksums K.2 Exact Reproduction Commands The nal pipeline is deterministic given its seed. The reported run used seed 20261105, n = 500 personas, and 18 sessions. Local (Windows PowerShell). python 02_code/pipeline/loklok_pipeline_v8.py ` --root . --n-personas 500 --sessions 18 --seed 20261105 ` --embedding-model BAAI/bge-m3 --device cpu python 02_code/pipeline/generate_figures.py --root . pdflatex -interaction=nonstopmode thesis_final.tex (three passes) Local (Linux/macOS or Colab). python 02_code/pipeline/loklok_pipeline_v8.py \ --root . --n-personas 500 --sessions 18 --seed 20261105 \ --embedding-model BAAI/bge-m3 --device cuda python 02_code/pipeline/generate_figures.py --root . R reproduction. The R scripts reproduce the measured-wave psychometrics, the CFA with lavaan, the factorial summaries, and the Bayesian cross-check. The R path is optional for the Python pipeline but is included for audit:

APPENDIX K. REPRODUCIBILITY AND FINAL UPGRADE ARCHIVE 309 Rscript 02_code/R/01_measured_wave.R Rscript 02_code/R/02_cfa_invariance.R Rscript 02_code/R/03_bayes_crosscheck.R Colab. The archive includes LOKLOK_Thesis_Full_Run_T4.ipynb and LOKLOK_Quick_Validate_CPU.ipynb. The T4 notebook installs the dependencies, checks nvidia-smi, runs the pipeline, regenerates the gures, and zips the outputs. The CPU notebook runs a smaller validation conguration. Both notebooks are self-documenting and use the same seed as the reported run. APPENDIX K. REPRODUCIBILITY AND FINAL UPGRADE ARCHIVE 310 Table K.2: Final ClaimEvidence Matrix Claim Evidence tier Status Permitted wording Measured PBstar association Measured eld Observed Participants' PB ratings were associated with stars Measured reliability Measured eld Observed, limited Internal consistency was high; structural validity was not established G1G0 evaluative rating contrast Model-based Strong within model The calibrated model produced a positive contrast G1G0 competenceformat contrast Model-based Strong within model The synthetic NMLS prole rose under G1 Engagement cost Model-based Strong within model The model produced an engagement trade-o Misinformation suppression Model-based Strong within model The governance bundle suppressed false reach in stress tests Parameter robustness Model-based Conditional The contrast survived the specied sweep; it was prior-sensitive Human learning gain Not measured Untested Requires longitudinal conrmatory deployment BRS consequential ranking Not validated Not established BRS is a proposed metric, not a validated ranking instrument Thermodynamic law Theoretical analogy Not a law The Hamiltonian is a formal diagnostic K.4 Final ClaimEvidence Matrix K.5 Defense Questions Specic to the Upgrade You generated 500 personas. Isn't that a fake sample? The personas are a computational population drawn from a debiased prior anchored in the 52 measured records. They are not presented as additional respondents. The 23 design is within-persona, so the contrast is paired by construction; the model's uncertainty is reported separately from sampling uncertainty in the eld wave.

APPENDIX K. REPRODUCIBILITY AND FINAL UPGRADE ARCHIVE 311 Why should I believe the narrow intervals? You should not read them as human population intervals. They are repeatedsampling intervals across generated personas in a deterministic model. The thesis says this explicitly and reports the measured-wave uncertainty separately. The Hamiltonian did not decrease. Does that falsify EST-P2? It falsies the strong claim that this particular operationalisation must minimise the diagnostic. The thesis reports the sign honestly and treats the Hamiltonian as a specication device. The diversity and echo results still support the conditional mechanism, but the thermodynamic language is not promoted to a law. Why is the skeptical prior result so dierent? Because a prior with standard deviation 0.15 is extremely skeptical about an eect of about one rating point. The thesis reports the full prior sensitivity rather than selecting the most favourable prior. The moderate skeptical prior still yields a positive interval; the extreme prior is a stress test. What is genuinely new in the upgrade? The integrated, reproducible pipeline: four-stream embedding, DML/IPW debiasing, spectral manifold, within-persona 23 tensor ABM, eight lters, Zewailinspired attention gate, GRM-IRT measurement, dual inference, adversarial misinformation tests, Sobol sensitivity, and a complete archive. The individual components are borrowed; the integration and the explicit claim ceilings are the contribution.

APPENDIX K. REPRODUCIBILITY AND FINAL UPGRADE ARCHIVE 312 Why include the Arabic front matter and the Zewail analogy? The Arabic title page and abstract meet the ACU/SCU front-matter requirement. The Zewail analogy gives the attentional gate a precise, falsiable timeresolved form. It is labelled as a formal analogy, not as a claim that social listening is chemistry. K.6 Final Quality Gate 1. Every major claim identies its evidence tier (measured, model-based, theoretical, or future empirical). 2. Measured and simulated results are never merged into one table without a label. 3. All causal language about G0/G1 is conditional on the model. 4. The measured N = 52 matrix is not altered to improve signicance. 5. The synthetic NMLS prole is not presented as human media literacy. 6. The Hamiltonian is not presented as a physical law. 7. The BRS is not presented as a validated consequential ranking. 8. The skeptical-prior result is reported, not hidden. 9. The archive contains the code, data, seeds, outputs, gures, R scripts, and Colab notebooks needed to reproduce the model-based results. 10. The Arabic front matter is included and the English abstract remains the primary abstract.
